subject: Incident: FastLedger throughput surge — data-handling & evidence Qs
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@fastledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FastLedger Incident Response <ops@fastledger.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: High error rate & latency spike — immediate ask

Hi Marissa,

We observed a sharp throughput drop at ~07:22 PDT this morning: tail latency jumped above 3s for many requests and error rate rose to ~8% for our production tenant (account ID FL-2027). This is impacting our billing cutover and two customer-critical batch jobs.

FastLedger needs two things ASAP for our internal postmortem and to satisfy our audit team:
- A slice of runtime logs (token-level traces) for 07:15–07:45 PDT for model routes: /v1/generate (model: rwd-7b-v2)
- Confirmation of retention policy and whether any ephemeral KV cache snapshots could contain PII for those sessions

Can you confirm what you can provide within the next 4 hours? If you need a signed NDA or legal contact, let me know.

Thanks,
Sara Li
Senior Ops Lead, FastLedger
ops@fastledger.com

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@fastledger.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate & latency spike — immediate ask

Sara — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. We're on it. Quick status and plan:

1) I'll coordinate collection of the runtime traces for 07:15–07:45 PDT and ship a secure, access-restricted bundle.
2) Sean / Monica: can you confirm what we currently retain for rwd-7b-v2 route (trace retention, KV snapshots, masking rules) and whether anything in those artifacts is considered PII by our policy?
3) If FastLedger requires a legal agreement for artifact delivery, I can escalate to legal — cc Monica.

Sara — will update in 90 minutes with a first-pass ETA or the bundle.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: forensics-instructions.pdf (1-page guidance for artifact submission)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate & latency spike — immediate ask

Marissa / Monica — quick technical note:

- What we can produce within the next 2 hours: runtime traces (token-level event logs) for the route and the KV-cache snapshot taken at 07:30 PDT (we keep ephemeral cache snapshots for 48 hours by default for debugging). I will redact IPs and agent cookies by default.
- What may contain customer data: the KV-cache could include short user-provided prefixes (prompt text). We have a masking step but it is conservative — I recommend we deliver the raw bundle into an access-controlled S3 bucket and include a checksum and an explicit redaction request from FastLedger before wider distribution.
- Legal hold: we can place the artifacts under our internal legal hold only if FastLedger confirms a formal evidence request.

I'll start packaging traces now. Referenced filenames once packaged: redwood_runtime_trace_FASTLEDGER_20280505.zip and kv-cache-snapshot-20280505.txt

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

On Tue, May 5, 2028 at 08:25, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sara — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. We're on it. Quick status and plan:
> ...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@fastledger.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate & latency spike — immediate ask

Sara — packaged and shared a secure bundle to the FastLedger incident folder. Links and steps:

- Bundle: redwood_runtime_trace_FASTLEDGER_20280505.zip (S3 link sent to your ops alias)
- KV snapshot: kv-cache-snapshot-20280505.txt (access-restricted)
- We redacted known internal IPs and agent cookies, but left prompt text intact pending your redaction request.
- If you need the raw unredacted KV snapshot forensics sign-off, please request in writing (ops@fastledger.com) and Monica will coordinate legal hold and evidence transfer.

Summary of retention/handling:
- Runtime traces: retained for 30 days by default for production tenants; we can extend preservation to 1 year upon formal evidence request.
- KV cache snapshots: ephemeral (48h), archived only when a forensics bundle is created and put on legal hold.
- Access controls: bundles are encrypted at rest and access is logged. We will provide audit logs for any access within the bundle TTL.

I've attached a one-page guide (forensics-instructions.pdf) that outlines the process and acceptable next steps.

Marissa

Attachments: redwood_runtime_trace_FASTLEDGER_20280505.zip (delivered), kv-cache-snapshot-20280505.txt (delivered)
From: Sara Li <sara.li@fastledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: FastLedger Incident Response <ops@fastledger.com>
Date: 2028-05-06T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate & latency spike — immediate ask

Thanks Marissa / Sean — bundle received and we've started our triage. A few follow-ups from our compliance team:

1) Please provide an access log excerpt (who downloaded or listed the bundle) from 07:15–11:00 PDT on 2028-05-05.
2) Confirm the redaction process timeline if we formally request unredacted KV data.
3) We will open a formal evidence request (DOCS-REDWOOD-INCIDENT-2028-05-05). Please hold the artifacts under legal hold until further notice.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sara Li
Senior Ops Lead, FastLedger
ops@fastledger.com
